title: Auto Loans: the rate before discounts when autopay is cancelled
content:
# Auto Loans: the rate before discounts when autopay is cancelled

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a borrower cancels the autopay enrollment standing on an auto loan. It fixes the rate before discounts from which the APR recorded with the cancellation is rebuilt.

## Clause

The rate before discounts is the loan's recorded APR plus the discounts that the loan's recorded list of discounts shows as included in it:

- the product's autopay discount, when the list names autopay;
- the product's relationship discount, when the list names relationship.

Those recorded discounts, taken together, count for no more than the product's discount cap.

## The recorded list, read as a table

| Recorded list of discounts | Added back to the recorded APR |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| autopay | the autopay discount |
| relationship | the relationship discount |
| autopay and relationship | both discounts together, but no more than the discount cap |

## Worked case (illustrative discount sizes, not product values)

For illustration only, take an autopay discount of 0.30, a relationship discount of 0.30 and a discount cap of 0.40.

| Recorded APR | Recorded list | Added back | Rate before discounts |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6.70 | autopay and relationship | 0.30 plus 0.30 is 0.60, limited to 0.40 | 7.10 |
| 6.80 | autopay | 0.30 | 7.10 |
| 7.10 | none | nothing | 7.10 |

## Points of judgement

**Wrong reading:** "add back the full size of both discounts whenever the list names both." **Correct basis:** taken together they are added back only up to the discount cap.

**Where is the recorded list read from?** From the loan record, as it stands when the cancellation is handled.
